data.name: FROG RAIN
data.detailed_description:
Story:

Strange weather has returned to the city.

If the rain catches you, you turn into a frog. When it passes, you’re human again.

Nobody knows where the Frog Rain comes from, or when it’ll return.

Most people have gotten used to it by now.

But for a new kid like me, the Frog Rain might be my best chance to make some friends.

In these strange, peaceful days, I begin to draw closer to the people around me, glimpsing the desires they keep hidden, the secrets they never speak of, and all the quiet things in between...

Gameplay:

A story-driven visual novel with multiple routes, where your choices shape how the story unfolds.

Explore intimate relationships and character growth, with some routes featuring romance or horror.

  • A script of over 200,000 Chinese characters

  • 4 main characters main characters with unique interactions

  • 10 endings

  • 3–5 hours per playthrough

  • 10–15 hours to complete all routes

Characters:

  • Main Characters (5):

Chun Ran: The protagonist. New school, new start, new friends... hopefully. Unfortunately, these four are her only options.

Jin Xiao: Straight-A student. Looks down on everyone. You included.

Bu Yuezhi: Looks like he woke up in a bad mood and never quite got over it. Smells faintly of disinfectant.

Ku Limu: There’s something off about the way she talks and acts. Maybe that’s why the rest of the class keeps their distance.

Tian Sinong: Campus peddler. Dubious merchandise, zero volume control.

Content Warnings:

  • Not all characters are romanceable.

  • The game contains LGBTQ+ themes and same-sex romance.

  • One route features a three-way romantic dynamic, where the protagonist can become romantically involved with two characters at the same time.

  • The story explores themes including surrealism, loneliness, death, trauma, and deception, and contains depictions of murder, suicide, violence, and blood. Some scenes may be emotionally intense or distressing.

  • Contains non-sexual nudity.

  • Contains a considerable number of frogs.

  • This is a work of fiction. Any resemblance to real people, groups, events, or organizations is purely coincidental.

Please play with your own preferences and comfort level in mind.

Development Plans:

  • Current Progress

As of September 2026, the full 200,000+ word script is complete.Work on the art and scene direction is now underway. We’ll be sharing dev updates and sneak peeks on Weibo and Xiaohongshu (RedNote), so feel free to follow us there! ^_^

  • Demo — Late 2026

The demo will cover the story leading up to the route split, with around 30,000 Chinese characters of text and an estimated playtime of 1-2 hours.

  • Full Release — Summer 2027

The full game is planned for release in summer 2027, with Chinese and English language support. A Japanese version is currently under discussion.

  • Work in Progress

Story content, presentation, UI, and character designs shown during development are subject to change and may differ from the final release.

Development Team:

汉谟拉比炒面&我的屁是香哒（MM&PP）: An indie creative duo focused on original comics and visual novels.

data.short_description: A sudden downpour turns everyone caught in the rain into frogs. Now I’m surrounded by frogs, and I can’t tell my teachers from my classmates. But that’s beside the point. It’s a new school, after all. I’d better make some friends soon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible / DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz 64-bit Intel-compatible or Apple M1+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse
